base_checkpoint_selection: lowest rounded-count overall validation MSE from one fresh shadow-weighted training run; step-zero fallback
strength_selection: lowest rounded validation count MSE strictly below clipped per-plane bicubic, with no pooled or per-group overall/shadow/highlight/detail MSE increase; unchanged exact region_guard
final_evaluation: only if a nonzero candidate qualifies; freeze checkpoint SHA before final-reference evaluation; no final pixels to select strength
motivation: existing unweighted candidate regresses in pooled and both validation-group shadows at every tested strength; shadow weighting changes training loss, not quality guards
limitations: same historical references; not a newly unseen test set
